column1: Purpose: Compares your planned (budgeted) personal and business amounts against what actually happened each month, pulling actuals straight from each month's tab.
1. Every month's Actual, Total, and Income/PNL columns in the table below pull automatically from that month's own tab.
2. Planned columns pull from the Personal (Planned) and Business (Planned) tables further down this sheet.
3. Replace the example categories and amounts in the first Personal (Planned) and Business (Planned) tables with your own before you start tracking.
4. The second set of Personal (Planned) and Business (Planned) tables is extra room for more budget line items. Both sets add together into the Planned totals above.
